text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted Dantsu Flame in the academy hallway.

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I'm gonna be late for my part-time job...!! I'll make it up to you next time!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's fine, it's fine~ Don't worry about it at all! I'll take care of the cleaning, so have a good shift~!
And then on another day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Everything on this memo, right? Got it! I'll go buy them secretly so no one notices~

text_block_list.name: Dormmate Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for always asking you to do the behind-the-scenes stuff. Are you sure it's okay to leave it to you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's totally okay~ I really hope the surprise party turns out to be a great success!
Whenever I see her, she's always doing favors for someone. I was starting to worry if she was having a hard time, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, ah, w-whoa, it's gonna fall~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Auuu~~ Maybe trying to carry it all in one go was impossible after all.
choice_data_list: Could that be another favor for someone?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Eh? Um, yes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I was asked to take the bulky trash from cleaning the cafeteria down to the disposal area~
Dantsu Flame spoke lightly, but including the items that fell, it was an absurdly large load to carry all at once.
choice_data_list: Isn't that way too much for one person?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah~ Well, you see, the thing is—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Before this, teacher also handed me the recyclables. So I thought, since I'm going anyway, I might as well do it all together...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I guess I got a little too carried away with enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yes! Because, you know, it makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: When someone's in trouble and thinking 'what do I do~?', they remember "me"—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that mean "I" truly exist in that person's thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I think that's such an amazing thing~ That's why I just naturally want to be relied on.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, plus! When I'm in trouble, others help me out too, so I feel like we're just even~
Ah, there you are, Dantsu-chan~~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —Ehh~! Is this for me?

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Yep! It's a thank-you gift for covering my cleaning duty the other day!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: It's a body cream with a super nice scent. It has such a soothing vibe, just like you, Dantsu-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah~~, I'm so happy! You went out of your way to pick this for me, right? Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Geez, I'm the one who should be thanking you! Thank you for always helping me out with a big smile whenever I'm in trouble!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I didn't really do anything that special, though.
choice_data_list: No, I still think it's truly amazing.
No, I still think it's truly amazing.

text_block_list.text: Helping others without hesitation brings kindness right back in return. Seeing such a wonderful cycle warmed my heart.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hearing you say that... Fufu, it gives me a warm and fuzzy feeling inside too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: All right~~! I'll have to keep doing my best to be even more helpful from now on!
